scope: Composer typeahead and durable inline agent/skill references; user and assistant message presentation.
design: Prompt Bar interaction and row geometry, using local popover/menu/type tokens, agent avatar palette and identity-purple for skills.
interaction: Typing-only triggers; no explicit slash or mention buttons.

flicker.fix: Keep the visible portal under document.body while Lexical repositions its caret anchor. Preserve listbox ownership with aria-owns.

checks.command: bunx biome check <19 changed reference/composer files>
bunx playwright test --config playwright.conversation.config.ts conversation.spec.ts -g 'queued edit/delete|queued composer edit'

checks.check: Chromium-resolved chip foreground/background WCAG contrast for 20 avatar colors in two themes

boundaries: Browser tests use real HTTP, domain services and SQLite with the existing deterministic harness fixture; no new native-provider inference or billing proof.
The assistant Markdown fixture is supplied at the snapshot boundary to verify shared rendering and code/link preservation.
Skills come from the scoped inventory: enabled pinned application assignments, inherited harness packages and enabled native entries.
Qualified text references request a skill through the existing harness/product-tool behavior; they do not install skills or change assignments.
Text/reference-only drafts are retained per conversation in sessionStorage. Local files retain their existing submit-time/IndexedDB lifecycle.
No commit, push, deployment, installer work or unrelated backend changes were performed by this task.
